# The Living Indexes

> The Living Indexes: a source-backed catalog published by Kymata Labs.

Snapshot collected: 2026-11-02T19:35:15.070137+00:00
Current catalog records: 17

## Sources and interpretation

- [Published sibling index snapshots](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/)
- [Collection and scoring source](https://github.com/tekvisions/living-indexes/blob/main/build_data.py)

This hub reads each sibling data.json and links to its own methodology. GitHub-discovery directories, commit-velocity trackers, the official MCP registry directory and Hugging Face Model Radar use different signals. Counts sum catalog records rather than unique products across the fleet; unknown sibling counts are omitted from the sum.

## Readable and structured resources

- [Catalog](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/)
- [Selection guide and evidence limits](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/#catalog-guidance)
- [Methodology and snapshot date](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/#catalog-methodology)
- [Raw dated source snapshot (JSON; older upstream summaries may precede inclusion review)](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/data.json)
- [Reviewed dated hub summaries (JSON)](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/catalog.json)
- [Sitemap of published pages](https://indexes.kymatalabs.com/sitemap.xml)
